test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All pens are sketches.

II. All sketches are books.

III. Some books are colours.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are pens.

II. Some colours are sketches.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

I. All pens are sketches.

II. All sketches are books.

III. Some books are colours.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/266af87d1616e8b7fb4b39ef2b20ea62b7405a1f3c8432fdbb8ec5bff5a205da.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are pens - **True **(Because, those parts of books which are sketches are also part of pens)

II. Some colours are sketches- False (Because, No definite relation is given between colours and sketches, so this can be a possibility only)

So, only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
